CANONICAL RULES (every indexable page sets its own `alternates.canonical`, absolute https://countrivo.com/...; root layout has NO canonical any more, metadataBase = https://countrivo.com):
- `/` : canonical https://countrivo.com (src/app/page.tsx), `dynamic = "force-dynamic"`.
- `/games`: canonical https://countrivo.com/games.
- `/games/{slug}` (17 landings): canonical `/games/{slug}` (relative, via buildGameMetadata in src/lib/seo/game-metadata.ts; resolved against metadataBase). `/games/world-draft`: canonical https://countrivo.com/games/world-draft (own metadata in page.tsx).
- `/countries`: canonical https://countrivo.com/countries. `/countries/{slug}`: canonical https://countrivo.com/countries/{slug} (generateMetadata + generateStaticParams, static 243).
- `/categories`: canonical https://countrivo.com/categories. `/categories/{slug}`: canonical https://countrivo.com/categories/{slug} (generateStaticParams, static 21).
- `/lists`: canonical https://countrivo.com/lists. `/lists/{slug}` (15): canonical https://countrivo.com/lists/{slug} each.

NOINDEX RULES:
- `/games/{slug}/play` (17 play pages): `robots: { index: false, follow: true }`, title "{Title} · Play". Mode via `?mode=daily|practice`; no `?mode=` = practice by design. Footer hidden on any path containing "/play" (FooterGate).
- `/games/[slug]/leaderboard` (dynamic, `?date=YYYY-MM-DD&tab=friends`): `robots: { index: false, follow: true }`, title "{Title}: Today's Board".
- `/games/[slug]/run/[runId]` (dynamic, Supabase): `robots: { index: false }`, title "{displayName}'s {Title} · {date}"; "Run not found" also noindex.
- `/auth/forgot-password`, `/auth/reset-password`: `robots: { index: false, follow: false }`.
- `/profile` (redirects to / when signed out), `/profile/[username]`, `/friends` (redirect when signed out), `/friends/add/[username]`: no explicit robots (inherit index:true) but not in any sitemap; titles "My Profile", "{username}", "Friends", "Add {username}". `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/support`: indexable, not in sitemap, titles "Privacy Policy" / "Terms of Service" / "Support".
- `/auth/callback` is a route handler (only route.ts in the app).

REDIRECTS (next.config.ts `redirects()`, all permanent 308): `/vs/:code` -> `/games`; `/games/countryle` -> `/games`; `/games/countryle/play` -> `/games`. Known gap (memory seo-audit-2026-08): www.countrivo.com serves 200 with no redirect to apex; must be fixed at Vercel domain level (no vercel.json in repo).

tables.name: profiles (base table; CREATE not in repo, lives only in live DB project reqvdyfzwkrtlvgapnyq; columns reconstructed from code + migrations)
tables.columns: id uuid PK references auth.users(id) on delete cascade (delete-account edge fn relies on cascade); username text UNIQUE (3-20 chars, /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,18}[a-z0-9]$/ enforced in updateUsername; trigger-generated defaults: email local-part or 'guest'/'user' + numeric discriminator, see handle_new_user); display_name text null (1-30 chars, profanity filter isAllowedHandle); avatar_url text null (never written by app code); country_code text null (ISO3 from the profile form; older rows may hold ISO2 -> src/lib/silhouettes.ts iso2ToIso3/toFlagCode accept both); streak_current int default 0; streak_longest int default 0; last_daily_date date null (YYYY-MM-DD string in JS); streak_freezes smallint not null default 2 (migration 20260620110000); streak_frozen_dates date[] not null default '{}' (same migration); created_at timestamptz; updated_at timestamptz. Read shapes: src/types/server.ts Profile {id, username, displayName, avatarUrl, countryCode, streakCurrent, streakLongest, lastDailyDate, createdAt}; home.ts ProfileRow {id, username, display_name, country_code, streak_current}.
tables.rls: Policies not in repo. Observed behaviour the code depends on: anon key can SELECT id/username/display_name/country_code/streak_current for any user (home.ts getPublicBoards uses a bare anon client with no session); authenticated users can UPDATE their own row (auth-provider joinAsGuest updates display_name via the BROWSER client; profile.ts updates display_name/country_code/username/updated_at; game-runs.ts updateStreak writes streak_current/streak_longest/last_daily_date/streak_freezes/streak_frozen_dates with the user's own session -> RLS must allow own-row UPDATE of those columns); anyone signed in can SELECT any profile (search by username/display_name ilike, friends lists, public profile page by username). INSERT is done only by the SECURITY DEFINER trigger handle_new_user.
tables.triggers: handle_new_user() AFTER INSERT ON auth.users (trigger itself created outside repo; function body redefined three times, latest = migration 20260828120000_handle_new_user_anonymous.sql): username := lower(regexp_replace(split_part(coalesce(new.email,''),'@',1),'[^a-z0-9_]','','g')); empty -> 'guest' if new.is_anonymous else 'user'; truncated to 20; on collision append attempt number 1..9999, then '_'+first 8 chars of uuid; INSERT profiles(id, username, display_name=username, created_at, updated_at) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING. (Migration 20260620100000 had replaced this with gen_geo_handle() random 'adjective-noun-123' handles and scrubbed email-derived handles; 20260828 reverted to email-derived + anonymous support, so gen_geo_handle() still exists in the DB but is no longer called by the trigger.)

tables.name: game_runs (base table; CREATE not in repo)

actions.signature: submitGameRun(input: { gameSlug: string; mode: 'daily'|'practice'; dateKey: string; scoreRaw: number; scoreMax: number; scoreSortValue: number; scoreDisplay: string; resultJson: Record<string, unknown>; startedAt: string }): Promise<{ success: boolean; run?: ServerGameRun; error?: string }>
actions.purpose: THE run-submission contract. Order of checks: (1) auth.getUser() else 'not_authenticated' (anonymous/guest sessions count as authenticated); (2) scoreRaw > scoreMax when scoreMax > 0 -> 'invalid_score'; (3) validateGameResult(gameSlug, scoreRaw, scoreMax, resultJson) structural cross-check, errors: 'invalid_result' | 'score_mismatch' | 'score_exceeds_total' | 'unvalidated_game' (unknown slug) | 'validation_error'; (4) daily: dateKey silently replaced by server getTodayDateKey() (Europe/Berlin); (5) daily replay validation with edition = getDailyEdition(): country-draft -> validateCountryDraftResult, stat-guesser -> validateStatGuesserResult, failure -> 'server_validation_failed: <reason>'; (6) scoreSortValue ALWAYS overridden server-side: = scoreRaw for risk-zone, cluster, flag-quiz, capital-match, odd-one-out, country-streak, speed-flags, blitz, continent-sprint, border-buddies, population-sort, stat-guesser, supremacy, higher-or-lower; = 1944 - scoreRaw for country-draft (8*243, lower raw is better); = scoreMax - scoreRaw for geo-wordle and borderline (fewer guesses better); (7) startedAt must parse and be <= now+5s else 'invalid_start_time'; elapsed < 3000 ms -> 'too_fast'; (8) IDEMPOTENCY: SELECT existing game_runs WHERE user_id, game_slug, started_at = input.startedAt -> if found return {success:true, run: existing} (boards submit twice after auth change + join callback); (9) daily: rpc ensure_daily_puzzle(slug, dateKey, dateSeed(dateKey+slug)) -> daily_puzzle_id; (10) INSERT game_runs {user_id, game_slug, daily_puzzle_id, mode, daily_date (daily only), score_raw, score_max, score_sort_value, score_display, result_json, started_at, completed_at=now}; unique violation 23505 -> 'already_played'; (11) daily: rpc compute_daily_rankings then updateStreak(); (12) re-select run; read user_game_stats(best_sort_value,total_runs) (already includes this run via trigger); PERSONAL BEST RULE: isPersonalBest = scoreRaw > 0 && stats exists && total_runs > 1 && scoreSortValue >= best_sort_value; if so UPDATE game_runs.is_personal_best=true; returns mapGameRun(run,isPersonalBest). Per-game resultJson requirements (validateGameResult): flag-quiz/capital-match: answers[] (either picked-index numbers|null + numeric score === scoreRaw, or {correct} objects whose correct-count === scoreRaw), scoreRaw <= answers.length; odd-one-out: answers[], score === scoreRaw, scoreRaw <= answers.length; higher-or-lower: streak === scoreRaw; country-streak: streak === scoreRaw, <= 243; speed-flags: correct === scoreRaw, <= total if present; population-sort: score === scoreRaw, userOrder[] and correctOrder[] same length; stat-guesser: avgError number, |round(max(0,100-avgError)) - scoreRaw| <= 1; country-draft: playerScore === scoreRaw, and if optimalScore & gap present |(player-optimal)-gap| <= 1; border-buddies: found[] length === scoreRaw <= scoreMax; continent-sprint: found number === scoreRaw <= scoreMax; geo-wordle: guesses[] 1..6, won boolean, answerIso3 string; won -> scoreRaw === guesses.length and last.correct === true; lost -> scoreRaw === 6 and 6 guesses; cluster: solved === scoreRaw in 0..4, scoreMax === 4, mistakes 0..4, not (solved 4 and mistakes >= 4), guesses (if present) array with length >= solved+mistakes; risk-zone: score === scoreRaw, chains[] length <= 5, sum(chains[].points) === scoreRaw <= scoreMax; blitz/supremacy/borderline: accepted without checks (but those boards never call submitGameRun). Actual board payloads: border-buddies {found, total, country, borders} display 'X / Y'; capital-match & flag-quiz {score,total,answers} 'X / Y'; cluster {solved,mistakes,groups,guesses} scoreMax 4; continent-sprint {found,total,continent,elapsed}; country-draft {playerScore,optimalScore,gap,grade,stars,assignments[{countryIdx,categoryIdx,rank}],optimalAssignments,countryIso3s[8]} scoreMax 1944, display 'Score: N (Gap: G)'; country-streak {streak,bestStreak} scoreMax 243 'Streak: N'; geo-wordle {answerIso3,won,guesses[{iso3,distanceKm,proximityPct,arrow,band,correct}]} scoreMax 6; higher-or-lower {streak,bestStreak,totalRounds,lastAnswer} scoreMax = streak, 'Streak: N'; odd-one-out {score,total,answers}; population-sort {score,total,category,userOrder,correctOrder}; risk-zone {score,chains[{outcome,bankedAt,points}]} scoreMax RISK_MAX_SCORE, 'N pts'; speed-flags {correct,total,accuracy} scoreMax 100, 'N flags'; stat-guesser {avgError,totalError,scores,guesses,rounds,targetIso3s,targetIso3} scoreMax 100, 'X% avg error'. Daily RNG for every board = getDailyRng(getTodayDateKey(), edition) = mulberry32(dateSeed(dateKey + edition)) (country-draft: generateDraftConfig(rng,'daily',dateKey)); practice = mulberry32(Date.now()).
actions.callers: 14 boards: src/components/games/{border-buddies/border-board, capital-match/capital-board, cluster/cluster-board, continent-sprint/sprint-board, country-draft/draft-board, country-streak/streak-board, flag-quiz/flag-quiz-board, geo-wordle/geo-board, higher-or-lower/hol-board, odd-one-out/odd-board, population-sort/sort-board, risk-zone/risk-board, speed-flags/speed-board, stat-guesser/guesser-board}.tsx (each keeps pendingPayload state and calls openAuthModal(submit)/LeaderboardJoin when no session). blitz, supremacy, borderline, world-draft boards never submit.

actions.signature: updateStreak(supabase, userId: string, dateKey: string): Promise<void>
actions.purpose: STREAK RULE (aggregation, race-free): load distinct game_runs.daily_date for user, mode='daily', >= dateKey-365d, plus dateKey itself; read profiles.streak_longest, streak_freezes, streak_frozen_dates (falls back to streak_longest-only if freeze columns missing). Walk back day by day from dateKey: played day -> streak++; a missed day (not today) is bridged without counting if it is already in streak_frozen_dates, or if streak_freezes > 0 AND the day before it was played (spend one freeze, record the date); otherwise stop. Writes profiles {streak_current, streak_longest = max(old, streak), last_daily_date = dateKey, updated_at, streak_freezes = remaining, streak_frozen_dates = frozen dates within the 365-day window}. Any daily game counts; one daily per day is enough. No refill of freezes exists (docs suggest an optional weekly pg_cron).

actions.signature: getHomeData(): Promise<HomeData { dateKey: string; signedIn: boolean; meName: string|null; meCrest: string|null; streak: number|null; friendCount: number; boards: Record<slug, GameBoard>; draftCategories: string[] }>  // GameBoard { slug; shots: number; top: string|null; global: BoardRow[] (top 3); me: {rank, score}|null; friends: FriendRow[] }  // BoardRow { userId; name; flag: iso2 lowercase|null; crest: svg path|null; score; sort; rank; isMe }  // FriendRow { userId; name ('you' for self); crest; score|null; sort|null; isMe }
actions.purpose: Home aggregation. dailySlugs = registry games whose availableModes include 'daily' (country-draft, flag-quiz, higher-or-lower, capital-match, population-sort, country-streak, border-buddies, stat-guesser, odd-one-out, geo-wordle, cluster, risk-zone). Runs auth.getUser() and getPublicBoards(dateKey, dailySlugs) in parallel. Signed in: re-reads own today runs per request and merges over cached rows; reads accepted friendships (either direction) -> friendIds; fetches missing profiles. Per slug: sort runs by score_sort_value desc, rank = index+1, compactScore('Score: 635 (Gap: 424)' -> '635'; <=10-char display kept; else raw), flag = toFlagCode(country_code), crest = getSilhouettePath(iso2ToIso3(country_code)); friends board = [friends + self] with their score (or null), sorted by sort desc. draftCategories = generateDraftConfig(getDailyRng(dateKey, edition),'daily',dateKey).categories shortLabel||label (today's Country Draft stats are public by rule). meName = display_name || username; streak = streak_current. Env HOME_TIMING logs laps.
actions.caching: getPublicBoards = unstable_cache(async (dateKey, dailySlugs) => {runs, profiles, edition}, ['home-public-boards'], { revalidate: 30 }) using a bare anon @supabase/supabase-js client (persistSession:false); queries: game_runs (user_id, game_slug, score_display, score_raw, score_sort_value) where daily_date=dateKey, mode='daily', game_slug in dailySlugs, limit 5000; app_config value where key='daily_edition'; profiles (id, username, display_name, country_code, streak_current) in user ids. Every query has AbortSignal.timeout(6000); failure degrades to empty arrays. Viewer-specific queries are per request, never cached.

data.clients: Env: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (project ref reqvdyfzwkrtlvgapnyq, https://reqvdyfzwkrtlvgapnyq.supabase.co). No service-role key anywhere in the Next app; only edge functions use SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Server: src/lib/supabase/server.ts `export async function createClient()` = @supabase/ssr createServerClient with cookies from next/headers (getAll / setAll wrapped in try-catch, ignored inside Server Components; middleware refreshes). Browser: src/lib/supabase/client.ts `export function createClient()` = createBrowserClient(url, anon) (cookie-based session shared with the server; cookies are NOT HttpOnly). Middleware: src/middleware.ts -> src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts `updateSession(request)` creates a server client over request/response cookies and calls auth.getUser() to refresh; matcher excludes _next/static, _next/image, favicon.svg, /flags/, and *.svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|ico. Anon/no-session client: src/app/actions/home.ts creates `createAnonClient(url, anon, { auth: { persistSession: false } })` from @supabase/supabase-js inside unstable_cache for the public boards. Auth flows (src/components/auth/auth-provider.tsx, context useAuth(): {user, profile, loading, authModalOpen, openAuthModal(onSuccess?), closeAuthModal, signOut, joinAsGuest(displayName)}): on mount auth.getUser() with a 3 s timeout then fetchProfile (select * from profiles where id); onAuthStateChange defers all work with setTimeout(0) (Supabase auth lock deadlock), re-fetches profile guarded by profileGenRef, mirrors session to native storage, runs the pending post-sign-in callback unless PASSWORD_RECOVERY, closes the modal. openAuthModal short-circuits if a user (incl. anonymous) already exists. joinAsGuest: supabase.auth.signInAnonymously() (requires Anonymous provider enabled; error text 'Guest play is not enabled yet…'), sets userRef synchronously, then renames profiles.display_name through the BROWSER client (RLS own row), falling back to updateProfile server action; used by src/components/game/leaderboard-join.tsx (name-only join, max 30 chars, shown after daily runs). Auth modal (src/components/auth/auth-modal.tsx): signInWithPassword, signUp (email+password, instant login), native Sign in with Apple via signInWithIdToken (src/lib/native/apple-auth.ts, hashed nonce), updateUser({data:{full_name}}). Password reset: /auth/forgot-password (resetPasswordForEmail) -> /auth/callback/route.ts (the ONLY route handler; exchangeCodeForSession, validates `next` is a relative path, type=recovery -> /auth/reset-password, failures -> /auth/forgot-password?expired=1) -> /auth/reset-password (updateUser({password})). Native (Capacitor iOS, src/lib/native/session-fallback.ts): persistSession() mirrors access/refresh tokens to @capacitor/preferences key 'cv_session' after sign-in, rehydrateSession() on cold start via auth.setSession when cookies were purged, clearPersistedSession() on sign-out. Account deletion: profile-edit-form calls supabase.functions.invoke('delete-account') then auth.signOut(). Redirect URLs configured: https://countrivo.com/auth/callback and com.countrivo.app://login-callback. Server pages that read auth directly: src/app/page.tsx (via getHomeData), friends/page.tsx (redirect('/') when signed out), friends/add/[username]/page.tsx, games/[slug]/leaderboard/page.tsx (profiles id,country_code for flags), profile/page.tsx, profile/[username]/page.tsx. No realtime channels, no API routes besides /auth/callback.
data.notes: 1) SCHEMA GAP: supabase/migrations contains only 10 incremental files (2026-05-26 .. 2026-08-29). The base tables profiles, game_runs, daily_puzzles, user_game_stats, friendships, friend_challenges, app_config and the RPCs ensure_daily_puzzle, compute_daily_rankings, get_daily_leaderboard, get_run_detail, admin_reroll_daily, update_user_game_stats, recompute_user_game_stats exist only in the live DB (applied via dashboard/MCP; docs/decisions.md and docs/EXECUTION-PLAN.md are the paper trail). Everything above about them is reconstructed from the TypeScript callers; pull `supabase db dump --schema public` before rebuilding. The .temp folder shows a linked project (postgres/gotrue versions) but no schema. 2) Two different seeds: the puzzle a player sees = mulberry32(dateSeed(dateKey + edition)) (edition from app_config.daily_edition, '' by default); daily_puzzles.seed = dateSeed(dateKey + gameSlug) is stored but unused by engines. dateSeed = Java-style 32-bit string hash, abs(); getTodayDateKey() = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA', {timeZone:'Europe/Berlin'}); msUntilReset()/formatTimeUntilReset() in src/lib/daily-seed.ts; seededShuffle/seededPick in src/lib/seeded-random.ts. Boards persist in-progress state in localStorage (src/lib/storage.ts, prefix 'countrivo_', Set/Map-aware JSON): 'daily_{slug}_{date}_completed', 'daily_{slug}_{date}_result', 'lockout_{slug}_{date}_e{edition}' ({score, scoreDisplay, timestamp}), 'progress_{slug}_{date}_e{edition}'. Daily lockout applies to everyone (guests via localStorage, signed-in via checkDailyStatus). 3) Product rules encoded in data: daily = one run per (user, game, day) enforced by the game_runs unique constraint (23505 -> 'already_played'); practice runs are stored (mode='practice', daily_date null) and count toward user_game_stats/personal best but never toward boards, rankings or streaks. Ranking is always score_sort_value desc, computed server-side. Board display strings are produced by the boards (see submitGameRun payload list) and compacted on the home. 4) Registry (src/data/game-registry.json, 18 entries, GameMeta in src/types/game.ts: slug, title, shortDescription, description, emoji (dead, UI no longer renders emoji), difficulty easy|medium|hard, estimatedTime, category quiz|ranking|strategy|speed|knowledge, tier main|drill, isNew, isFlagship, availableModes ('daily'|'practice'|'archive'|'custom')[], route, comingSoon?). Daily-capable: country-draft (flagship, main), flag-quiz, higher-or-lower (main), capital-match, population-sort, country-streak, border-buddies, stat-guesser (main), odd-one-out, geo-wordle (main), cluster (main), risk-zone (main). Practice-only: continent-sprint, speed-flags, supremacy, borderline, blitz. world-draft: availableModes [] and comingSoon (route /games/world-draft). blitz/supremacy/borderline never submit to the server (no leaderboard). Accessors: src/lib/data/registry.ts (client-safe: gameRegistry, getAllGames, getGameBySlug, getFlagshipGame, getMainGames, getDrillGames) re-exported by src/lib/data/games.ts. 5) Static data: src/data/countries.json = Country[] (243) {iso2, iso3, name, displayName, slug, region, subregion, continent, flagEmoji, flagSvgPath '/flags/{iso2}.svg' (243 SVGs in public/flags), capital, borders: iso3[]}; accessors src/lib/data/countries.ts getAllCountries/getCountryByIso3/getCountryBySlug/getCountriesByRegion/getCountriesByContinent; src/data/categories.json = Category[] (21) {slug, label, shortLabel, clarifier?, unit, description, direction 'higher_is_better'|'lower_is_better'|'neutral', source, sourceYear, coveragePercent, emoji} with slugs: population, area-km2, gdp-per-capita, gdp, life-expectancy, urban-population-pct, internet-users-pct, fertility-rate, tourism-arrivals, forest-coverage-pct, unemployment-rate, military-spending-pct, renewable-energy-pct, inflation-rate, beer-consumption-per-capita, coffee-consumption-per-capita, wine-consumption-per-capita, education-spending-pct, health-spending-pct, arable-land-pct, fdi-inflow; accessors src/lib/data/categories.ts getAllCategories/getCategoryBySlug. src/data/stats.json = StatMap Record<iso3, Record<categorySlug, number|null>> (243 keys; also carries an extra 'surface-area' key not in categories); src/data/ranks.json = RankMap Record<iso3, Record<categorySlug, number>> (1 = highest value, computed by scripts/compute-ranks.ts); src/lib/data/ranks.ts getRank/getRanksForCountry/getStatValue/getTopCountries(slug, n) (sync imports) and src/lib/data/loader.ts getRanks()/getStats() (lazy dynamic import) plus `countries`, `categories`, `centroids` exports. src/data/borders.json Record<iso3, iso3[]>; capitals.json Record<iso3, string>; centroids.json Record<iso3, [lat, lng]> (237 of 243; used by geo-wordle); data-timestamps.json {generatedAt, entries: Record<'category:slug'|'country:slug'|..., {hash, lastModified}>} (296 entries; used by src/app/sitemap.ts lastmod and country pages 'Data updated'; rebuilt by scripts/build-data-timestamps.ts, only moves when content hash changes). src/data/silhouettes.json Record<iso3, svgPath> (173 countries from Natural Earth 110m fitted into a 100x100 box, 96 KB, SERVER ONLY via src/lib/silhouettes.ts getSilhouettePath(iso3)/iso2ToIso3/toFlagCode; rebuild: node scripts/build-silhouettes.mjs); src/data/mark-silhouettes.json Record<iso3, svgPath> for 12 countries (CHL, ISL, AUS, ESP, PRT, BRA, NGA, JPN, DEU, NOR, ARG, MDG; 10 KB, client-safe) used by src/components/home/game-mark.tsx <GameMark slug size /> (one SVG mark per game, viewBox 0 0 28 28). Other UI data components: <CountryFlag iso2 /> (src/components/ui/country-flag.tsx), <StatIcon slug /> (src/components/ui/stat-icon.tsx). Data pipeline scripts (never hand-edit JSON): scripts/fetch-country-data.ts (REST Countries + World Bank -> countries/stats/borders/capitals), compute-ranks.ts, fetch-centroids.ts, clarify-category-labels.ts, build-data-timestamps.ts, build-silhouettes.mjs, fetch-flags.ts, submit-indexnow.ts, check-crawler-access.ts. 6) Indexed/kept URLs: /, /games, /games/[slug] (landing), /games/[slug]/play (noindex), /games/[slug]/leaderboard (noindex), /games/[slug]/run/[runId] (noindex), /countries, /countries/[slug] (generateStaticParams), /categories, /categories/[slug] (generateStaticParams), /lists and 15 list pages, /friends, /friends/add/[username], /profile, /profile/[username], /auth/*, /privacy, /terms, /support; sitemaps: src/app/sitemap.ts + countries/sitemap.ts, games/sitemap.ts, lists/sitemap.ts; next.config.ts redirects /vs/:code, /games/countryle, /games/countryle/play -> /games (permanent) and extends htmlLimitedBots with AI crawlers. 7) Caching summary: only unstable_cache in home.ts (30 s, anon client); home page force-dynamic; country and category detail pages are static via generateStaticParams; no revalidatePath/Tag anywhere; every other action is uncached per request. 8) Dead/unused server code worth dropping in a rebuild: getUserGameStats, getMyOutgoingChallenges, completeChallenge, getDuelById, startQuickDuel, getRecentChallengeResults (ghost/quick duels have no UI and conflict with product rule 'no duels'), src/types/storage.ts DailyProgress/UserStats, hooks use-daily-challenge.ts. 9) Admin: single admin uid in src/lib/admin.ts gates the reroll button; the RPC re-checks it server-side.

DEMO (only these exist):
1. Flame (FLAME_CSS in lib-k.js, also compiled into flame-demo.html / countrivo-flame.gif at 44 frames x 50ms, 480x200 @2x):
   @keyframes fl-o {0% scaleY(1) skewX(0); 20% scaleY(1.06) skewX(-3deg); 45% scaleY(.96) skewX(2.5deg); 70% scaleY(1.04) skewX(-1.5deg); 100% scaleY(1) skewX(0)} -> .fl-outer 1.1s ease-in-out infinite, origin 12px 21px.
   @keyframes fl-m {0% scaleY(1) skewX(0); 30% scaleY(1.12) skewX(3deg); 55% scaleY(.92) skewX(-3deg); 80% scaleY(1.06) skewX(1deg); 100% …} -> .fl-mid .8s ease-in-out infinite, origin 12px 21px.
   @keyframes fl-c {0%,100% scaleY(1) scaleX(1); 50% scaleY(1.18) scaleX(.9)} -> .fl-core .55s ease-in-out infinite, origin 12px 20px.

   prefers-reduced-motion: all five animation:none.
2. Mode switch knob: .track i {transition:left .3s} (default 'ease'), toggled by .track.r {left:50%}. Label colour/weight swap is instant.
3. Legacy H flame (unused in K): @keyframes flick {0%,100% scale(1) rotate(0); 40% scale(1.06) rotate(-3deg); 70% scale(.97) rotate(2deg)} 1.6s ease-in-out, origin 50% 90%.
NO board-row entrance, NO carousel, NO tab underline animation, NO pane fade, NO hover states, NO press states, no scroll effects. Static screens rendered by render-k.mjs at 390x844 @3x after document.fonts.ready + 1800ms.

SITE (globals.css + components):
- Flame keyframes fl-o/fl-m/fl-c/fl-e copied exactly (same timings), scoped under .flame; reduced-motion none. OK.
- Mode switch knob: translateX 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1) (--ease-emphasis); label transition-colors 200ms.
- .mode-pane: pane-in translateY(8px)->0 .28s var(--ease-out) on every Daily/Practice switch.
- .board-rows > *: rows-in translateY(6px)->0 .32s var(--ease-out), stagger 40/80/120/160/200ms, re-keyed on `${slug}-${tab}` so it replays on every tab or carousel change.
- Board tab indicator: span h-0.5 rounded-full scale-x-0 -> scale-x-100 origin-left 300ms ease-emphasis (growing underline; not in demo).
- Carousel: native scroll-snap (snap-x mandatory, scroll-padding-inline 1.25rem), inactive card scale-[0.97] opacity-70 with transition 300ms ease-emphasis; dots width 6px->24px + colour 300ms; hover arrows fade opacity; requestAnimationFrame centre measurement on scroll.
- .shoot: transition transform .15s ease-out, background .2s; :active scale(.97); hover bg #b8432a text #fbfaf6.
- .game-card: transition transform .2s var(--ease-game) (bouncy cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)), :active scale(.97), hover bg elevated.
- Tab bar links active:scale-95, transition-colors. Header avatar active:scale-95, hover bg-gold.
- StreakBadge: streak-breath scale 1.08 350ms ease-game when the number rises; ResetLabel ticks every 30s and renders an empty 92px span until mounted.
- Global utility keyframes still present: fade-in, slide-up (opacity 0 -> 1: hides content until animation), scale-in, pulse (gold box-shadow ring), count-up, shake, streak-glow (brightness), feedback-slide, endgame-glow (box-shadow bloom), score-pop, verdict-reveal, shimmer, toast-in/out; .stagger-children/.stagger-result use opacity-0 starts.
- prefers-reduced-motion block collapses all durations to 0.01ms.

SITE desktop (lg): max-w-5xl two-column grid (lg:grid-cols-2 gap-x-12), left = switch + carousel + dots, right = sticky board (top-20) with the daily list underneath (list rendered twice: hidden lg:block / lg:hidden); header gains centred nav Play/Rankings/Friends and the reset label; footer full width. The demo defines nothing for desktop.
design.signature: The K3 idea ('Ein Board'): one ink card for today's Country Draft, then ONE leaderboard directly under it with Global and Friends as two tabs in the same list, so the whole loop (switch mode, see the game, see where you stand, see the other dailies) fits one phone screen without scrolling. Global rows carry real origin flags (26x18, r3); Friends rows and 'you' carry crests: the player's CHOSEN country outline (real Natural Earth geometry) in an ink circle, because friends usually live in the same country, so the crest is an identity not an address; waiting friends' crests are #cfcec6. The 'you' row is always present and highlighted #f1f0ea, showing '–' and 'no shot yet' until you shoot, then your rank and Erode score. Counters everywhere are terse middle-dot facts in the right corner of each head: '41 shots · top 635', '41 shots', '41 shots · 9 countries', '3 of 5 have shot', '6 games · 0 shot', '27 played · best 22', 'holds till 00:00', 'you're #2'. Copy voice: lowercase 'you', second person, short declaratives, no marketing ('Countries appear one at a time. Put each one on the stat where it ranks highest in the world. Eight picks, one shot.'; 'Bad day? Practice a board, it won't count.'; 'One shot per game, same board for everyone, 24 h.'). The CTA is a single word, 'Shoot'. The only colour is the burnt red #b8432a, spent on the flame, the live counter, NEW, and the friends link; everything else is ink on off-white with #f1f0ea surfaces and 1px #e9e8e1 hairlines. Type identity = Erode for the wordmark, the game title, and every score number (Erode numerals are the tell), system-ui for everything else. The flame actually burns (three tongues, breathing core, rising embers) beside the reset countdown in the header. Icons are a 24-grid 2px stroke set with a filled 'seed' dot; the active tab-bar icon carries its seed in the accent. Game marks say what the game is (Chile for Higher or Lower, dashed Iceland for GeoWordle, 8-slot board for Country Draft, conquered-world strip for World Draft). Radii are small (12 / 9 / 6 / 4), nothing is 20px round, nothing has a shadow or a blurred bar.
design.gapsVsSite:
Why it 'looks absolutely not like' K3, in order of visual weight:
1. COMPOSITION: the demo is one static Country Draft card followed immediately by the one board. The site (home-client.tsx / game-carousel.tsx) replaced the anchor with a 7-card horizontal carousel (Country Draft, Higher or Lower, Stat Guesser, GeoWordle, Cluster, Risk Zone, World Draft): a grey ghost card peeks at the right edge (opacity .7, scale .97, visibly sliced by the viewport), a dots row sits under it, hover arrows float over it, and the board re-targets whatever card is centred. K3 has no carousel, no dots, no arrows, no peek.
2. FOLD: demo shows header, switch, card, full board (3 rows + you) and the top of the list within 764px. Site card is 382px tall (rounded-2xl p-5 min-h-[300px] with the Shoot button in flow under the chips instead of absolutely positioned over them at right 14 / bottom 16) plus the date row (mb-4) and the dots row, so the board's tab row lands at y≈617 and the me-row at 701 under a fixed tab bar at 780; 'More dailies' is off-screen. The 'one board' idea is literally below the fold.
3. HEADER: demo = wordmark + 'resets in 17 h 37 m · flame 3' on the page background, 64px, nothing else. Site = sticky 56px white/80 backdrop-blur bar with a hairline border, grey flame '0' (text-cream-dim because streak is 0; demo flame is always #b8432a), a 'Sign in' text link, plus a separate date row 'Fri 28 Aug' with the reset label moved out of the header on mobile (ResetLabel is hidden lg:inline). Desktop adds a centred nav (Play/Rankings/Friends) that the demo never has.
4. LIST CONTENT: demo 'More dailies' = World Draft NEW (conquest-map mark), Higher or Lower, GeoWordle, Cluster, Stat Guesser with personal metas '27 played · best 22'. Site list = the leftovers (Flag Quiz, Capital Match, Population Sort, Country Streak, Border Buddies, Odd One Out) with 'no shots yet today' because the main games moved into the carousel; head counter '6 games' instead of '6 games · 0 shot'.
5. FOOTER: demo has none (tab bar only). Site appends a 4-column marketing footer (rounded-t-2xl, bg elevated, 'All 18 games →' in gold-ink, data credits, colophon) that turns the app screen into a website.
6. TAB BAR: demo pure #fff, 80px, no border, 40px page-colour fade above it, active icon with an accent seed dot. Site bg-surface/92 + backdrop-blur + border-t, 64px, generic outline icons (src/components/icons, no seed dot, 1.5/2px stroke), no fade, so the list is cut hard by the bar.
7. RADII: card 20 vs 12; switch 14 vs 12; Shoot 8 vs 6; me-row 8 vs 6; list-row hover 8 (demo none). Every corner is rounder, which reads 'iOS widget' rather than the demo's tighter print feel.
8. BOARD HEAD: demo tabs 'Global'/'Friends' with a 2px ink underline under the word only, counter '41 shots' in #b8432a; site draws a full-width border-b under the tab row, animates a scale-x underline on change, capitalises lowercase strings, and prints '1 shot today' in #9a3622 (gold-ink) instead of the accent.
9. CREST/FLAG DATA: demo global rows show flags and the me-row a filled ink crest with a silhouette. Site shows an 'A' initial in an ink circle (user without country_code) and a grey '?' circle (bg-cream-dim rgba .48) for the signed-out you-row; demo never shows initials and its muted crest is #cfcec6.
10. TYPE DETAILS: h2 28px vs 30px; wordmark tracking-tight vs none; kicker text-bg/75 (lighter) vs #a9aaa3; how-text leading-snug 1.375 vs 1.45, text-bg/70 vs #c9c8c1, max-w-[300px]; muted text rgba(23,24,26,.70) (darker, ~#5d5e60) vs #74756f; NEW and counters in #9a3622 vs #b8432a. Body font stack starts with -apple-system/Inter rather than plain system-ui (same face on Apple, differs elsewhere). Global tnum/ss01 feature settings the demo does not set.
11. MOTION: site adds pane-in slide, staggered row entrance on every tab/carousel change, growing tab underline, carousel scale/opacity fades, bouncy --ease-game press, hover colour on Shoot (turns red), hover bg on list rows; demo has only the flame and the .3s knob slide. globals.css still ships opacity-0 entrance utilities (slide-up, stagger-children, animate-in) and glow keyframes (pulse, endgame-glow, streak-glow) and the old hero-globe.tsx (radial blur-3xl glow + dashed orbit ring) that contradict the demo language.
12. CHIPS: site pr-24 (96px) vs 110px, gap-1.5 (6 ok), bg-bg/10 ≈ #2d2e2f (ok) text-bg/85 (ok); but because Shoot is not absolute the chip block does not wrap around the button. Non-draft cards get hand-made CSS/SVG 'Art' (bars, dot grids, silhouettes with '?') the demo never designed.
13. DARK MODE: site flips all tokens under prefers-color-scheme: dark (bg #17181a, elevated #26271f, accent #e07a5f) and inverts the card to light-on-dark; the demo is light-only, so any dark screenshot cannot match it.
14. STALE: globals.css comments still say Space Grotesk/gold #b8860b; CLAUDE.md 'Design System' block still lists gold #b8860b and per-game colour pairs (game-colors.ts returns neutral vars now). --shadow-* tokens, .nav-active::after gold bar, .rank-1 gold, .streak-badge glow, .cta-secondary etc. remain as legacy.

routes.purpose: The Country Draft board. Header row: Back link to /games/country-draft, GameMark + 'Country Draft', mode label 'Daily · one shot' / 'Practice · doesn't count'. Daily: <DailyLockoutGuard gameSlug='country-draft' gameEmoji='🎯' gameTitle='Country Draft' edition><DraftBoard mode='daily' edition/></DailyLockoutGuard>; practice: <DraftBoard mode='practice' edition/>. Footer hidden (FooterGate: pathname includes '/play'), BottomTabBar hidden (pathname endsWith '/play').
routes.rendering: DYNAMIC server component: `const { mode } = await searchParams` + `await getDailyEdition()` (src/lib/daily-edition.ts -> createClient() -> cookies() -> Supabase app_config select where key='daily_edition' .single()). This is why the home 'Shoot' click shows loading UI before the board: (1) src/middleware.ts -> src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts updateSession() awaits supabase.auth.getUser() (a network round-trip to Supabase Auth) on every matched request incl. the RSC navigation fetch, before any bytes stream; (2) the page itself awaits the app_config query; (3) because the route is dynamic, <Link> prefetch only carries the route down to the nearest loading.js boundary, so on click the router instantly paints a Suspense fallback and waits: the boundaries on this path are src/app/games/loading.tsx (GamesLoading: max-w-7xl, 12 x h-40 '.skeleton' cards) and src/app/games/country-draft/play/loading.tsx which does `export { GamePlayLoading as default } from '@/components/game/game-play-loading'` (max-w-5xl: h-5 w-16 + h-5 w-28 bars, centered h-10 w-48 bar, h-64/sm:h-80 rounded-2xl panel, 4 x h-12 w-24 pills; '.skeleton' = shimmer keyframes in globals.css:461-473). Neither fallback matches the real page (max-w-3xl with Back/title/mode row). (4) When the RSC payload lands, the SSR HTML of DraftBoard (src/components/games/country-draft/draft-board.tsx:253-266) is its `if (!mounted)` branch: `<div class="flex flex-col gap-6 animate-pulse">` with an h-10 bar, a 2/4-col grid of 4 x h-28 rounded-2xl blocks and an h-6 bar (a THIRD skeleton with different geometry); `mounted` flips only in useEffect (line 115) after hydration, so the board appears one effect-tick after hydration. The comment says 'Prevent hydration mismatch', but in daily mode init() = createGame(getDailyRng(getTodayDateKey(), edition), 'daily', dateKey) is deterministic and edition is passed from the server, so the gate is only needed for practice (mulberry32(Date.now())) — cluster-board.tsx:167 and risk-board.tsx:212 gate only `mode === 'practice' && !mounted`. (5) DailyLockoutGuard (src/components/game/daily-lockout-guard.tsx) renders children first, then in useEffect reads localStorage `countrivo_lockout_country-draft_{YYYY-MM-DD}_e{edition}` (getDailyLockout) and swaps the whole board for DailyPlayedMessage ('Already played today', score, 'Next daily challenge in', 'Play again (practice)', 'View leaderboard') -> a post-hydration content swap for returning players; then when useAuth().loading is false && user, calls checkDailyStatus() for rankDaily/percentile. (6) useDailyProgress (src/hooks/use-daily-progress.ts, PROGRESS_VERSION 4) restores `countrivo_progress_country-draft_{date}_e{edition}` in a mount effect via dispatch({type:'@@daily-progress/restore'}) -> board can jump from fresh to resumed state after first paint. (7) Root: AuthProvider starts loading:true, supabase.auth.getUser() on mount (3 s timeout) -> Header shows an animate-pulse avatar circle (header.tsx:177) until resolved. Board phases: playing (GameSessionTopBar, EndgameRamp, CountryReveal, 8 CategorySlot grid, PickFeedback, one free undo, keyboard 1-8 via useGameKeys) -> gameComplete 'Final pick locked in' reveal held RESULT_REVEAL_MS=60000 or 'See result →' -> result screen (grade, playerScore/optimal/gap, OptimalComparison, ShareCard, LeaderboardJoin for guests, 'Today's board' link, 4 'More games' cards). On result in daily mode: setDailyLockout(...) then submitGameRun payload {gameSlug:'country-draft', mode, dateKey, scoreRaw:playerScore, scoreMax:8*243, scoreSortValue:MAX-playerScore, scoreDisplay:`Score: ${playerScore} (Gap: ${gap})`, resultJson:{playerScore, optimalScore, gap, grade, stars, assignments, optimalAssignments, countryIso3s}, startedAt} (guest: held as pendingPayload until openAuthModal/joinAsGuest).

routes.notes:
WHY 'Country Draft' SHOWS LOADING UI BEFORE THE BOARD (click on home card -> /games/country-draft/play?mode=daily), in order:
1. src/components/home/game-card.tsx:123 renders a plain <Link href='/games/country-draft/play?mode=daily' class='shoot ...'>Shoot</Link> (inside HomeClient > GameCarousel; non-active cards are `inert`).
2. src/middleware.ts -> src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts updateSession() does `await supabase.auth.getUser()` for every matched request (the RSC navigation fetch included). That is a Supabase Auth HTTP round-trip before the first byte of the response.
3. src/app/games/country-draft/play/page.tsx is request-time dynamic: `await searchParams` and `await getDailyEdition()` (src/lib/daily-edition.ts: createClient() -> next/headers cookies() -> Supabase `app_config` select value where key='daily_edition' .single()). The page cannot render until that second round-trip resolves. Because the route is dynamic, <Link> prefetch only carries the tree down to the nearest loading.js boundary, so on click the client router immediately renders a Suspense fallback and waits for the server.
4. Fallbacks on this path: src/app/games/loading.tsx (GamesLoading — max-w-7xl heading bars + 12 x h-40 `.skeleton` cards; this boundary wraps every /games/* segment) and src/app/games/country-draft/play/loading.tsx = `export { GamePlayLoading as default } from '@/components/game/game-play-loading'` (max-w-5xl; h-5 w-16 + h-5 w-28 bars, centered h-10 w-48 bar, h-64 sm:h-80 rounded-2xl panel, four h-12 w-24 pills). `.skeleton` = shimmer keyframes in src/app/globals.css:461-473. Both fallbacks have different widths and geometry from the real play page (max-w-3xl with Back / GameMark+title / mode label row). Depending on what was prefetched, the user can see the outer /games grid skeleton first, then the play skeleton once streaming starts.
5. When the RSC payload arrives, the server-rendered HTML of <DraftBoard> (src/components/games/country-draft/draft-board.tsx) is its `if (!mounted)` branch (lines 253-266): `<div class='flex flex-col gap-6 animate-pulse'>` with an h-10 bar, a grid of 4 x h-28 rounded-2xl blocks and an h-6 bar — a THIRD skeleton. `mounted` is set in `useEffect(() => { setMounted(true); }, [])` (line 115), so the actual board (GameSessionTopBar, EndgameRamp, CountryReveal, 8 CategorySlots) paints only after hydration + one effect. The comment says 'Prevent hydration mismatch', but in daily mode `init()` = createGame(getDailyRng(getTodayDateKey(), edition), 'daily', dateKey) is deterministic (edition comes from the server as a prop) so the gate is only needed for practice (mulberry32(Date.now())) — cluster-board.tsx:167 and risk-board.tsx:212 correctly gate only `mode === 'practice' && !mounted`. Removing the daily-mode gate alone would make the board part of the SSR HTML.
6. src/components/game/daily-lockout-guard.tsx (DailyLockoutGuard) wraps the board in daily mode: it renders children first, then in a mount useEffect reads localStorage `countrivo_lockout_country-draft_{YYYY-MM-DD}_e{edition}` (getDailyLockout) and swaps the entire board for DailyPlayedMessage ('Already played today', score tile, 'Next daily challenge in Xh Ym' via useResetCountdown, 'Play again (practice)' -> ?mode=practice, 'View leaderboard') — a post-hydration content swap for returning players. When `useAuth().loading` is false and a user exists it then calls the checkDailyStatus server action to add rank/percentile.
7. src/hooks/use-daily-progress.ts (useDailyProgress, PROGRESS_VERSION=4) restores `countrivo_progress_country-draft_{date}_e{edition}` in a mount effect via dispatch({type:'@@daily-progress/restore'}) so a resumed run re-renders from the fresh board to the saved state after first paint.
8. Root chrome adds its own flicker: AuthProvider starts `loading: true` and calls supabase.auth.getUser() on mount (3 s timeout); Header renders `<div class='w-10 h-10 ... rounded-full bg-black/5 animate-pulse'/>` (header.tsx:177) until it resolves, then 'Sign in' + 'Today's shot' or the avatar; ResetLabel renders a blank 92px span until mounted; StreakBadge reads localStorage in an effect.
9. The landing page /games/country-draft is static but has the same class of post-hydration changes: PlayedTodayBanner returns null on SSR and inserts a banner after auth + checkDailyStatus; DateStamp renders an opacity-0 '00·00·00' <time> until useSyncExternalStore hydrates (server snapshot null); ResetLabel blank until mounted. Its 'Shoot today's' button goes through the exact chain above.
10. Home itself: force-dynamic + getHomeData() (auth getUser, unstable_cache'd public boards 30 s, then own runs, friendships, profiles sequentially, each with a 6 s AbortSignal timeout) and src/app/loading.tsx HomeLoading (whose max-w-7xl hero/featured/leaderboard/grid skeleton does not match the real home). HomeClient may flip Daily->Practice after reading countrivo_home_mode from localStorage in an effect.
Other visible loading strings: game-over-screen.tsx 'Loading…' (next/dynamic ShareCard fallback, ssr:false), challenge-friend-picker.tsx 'Loading friends...', Button loading spinner (animate-spin), forgot/reset forms 'Sending...'/'Updating...'.

WHAT MUST BE KEPT (rules/data/URLs): game engines in src/lib/game-logic/{slug}/ (pure, seeded RNG; country-draft has engine/generator/scoring/types/server-validate; stat-guesser has server-validate), src/lib/daily-seed.ts (Europe/Berlin dateKey, dateSeed, mulberry32, getDailyRng(dateKey, edition), msUntilReset), src/lib/daily-edition.ts (app_config.daily_edition salt; admin reroll via rerollDailyAction), src/lib/storage.ts key scheme (prefix countrivo_; daily_{slug}_{date}_completed, daily_{slug}_{date}_result, lockout_{slug}_{date}_e{edition}, progress_{slug}_{date}_e{edition}, home_mode), submitGameRun payload contract (gameSlug, mode, dateKey, scoreRaw, scoreMax, scoreSortValue, scoreDisplay, resultJson, startedAt) with server-side validation and 'Score: N (Gap: M)' display format that boards compact via /^Score:\s*([^\s(]+)/, RESULT_REVEAL_MS 60 s and the one free undo in Country Draft, DailyLockoutGuard semantics, guest flow (LeaderboardJoin -> joinAsGuest -> supabase.auth.signInAnonymously -> pendingPayload submit), src/data/*.json (never hand-edit; countries 243, categories 21, game-registry 18 entries, silhouettes, mark-silhouettes, borders, ranks, stats, capitals, centroids, data-timestamps), Supabase tables game_runs, profiles (username, display_name, avatar_url, country_code, streak_current, streak_longest, last_daily_date), app_config, friendships, challenges, device_tokens + RPC get_daily_leaderboard, migrations in supabase/migrations, env NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (HOME_TIMING debug), the four sitemaps + robots + redirects + /auth/callback + all landing/hub/country/category/list URLs and their canonicals/titles, verification meta, Capacitor iOS shell expectations (NativeBootstrap, /auth/callback deep link, pathname-based hiding of footer/tab bar on /play and /auth).

INCONSISTENCIES WORTH FIXING IN THE REBUILD: '17 games' hard-coded in root metadata/manifest/root OG vs 18 registry entries (og-image fallback says '18 games'; GameEntityBlock says '{gameRegistry.length} daily games'); home and /games titles get ' | Countrivo' appended by the template (brand twice) while game landings use {absolute}; most game landing pages emit the BreadcrumbList/VideoGame/FAQPage graph twice (page-level <GameJsonLd {...buildGameJsonLd()}/> plus GameLanding's own GameJsonLd); manifest theme/background #10141b and global-error colors (#10141b, #b8860b) and root OG gold #b8860b are stale vs the current palette (#fbfaf6/#17181a, accent #b8432a); /countries 'did you know' rotation is frozen at build time; the WebSite SearchAction points at /countries?q= which the page ignores; continent-sprint and speed-flags play pages accept ?mode=daily although the registry marks them practice-only; every loading.tsx skeleton uses a different max-width than its page; Inter is still loaded from Google despite the 'no Google fonts' rule; `middleware.ts` should become `proxy.ts` on Next 16; CountriesClient/HomeClient/DateStamp/ResetLabel all rely on post-mount effects; src/components/daily-hero.tsx, src/components/layout/hero-globe.tsx and src/hooks/use-daily-challenge.ts are dead (no importers). Server actions available: home.getHomeData; game-runs.{submitGameRun, checkDailyStatus, getDailyLeaderboard, getRunDetail, getDailySummary, getUserGameStats, getUserTodayRuns}; friends.{searchUsers, sendFriendRequest, respondToFriendRequest, removeFriend, getFriends, getPendingRequests, getFriendsLeaderboard}; challenges.{createChallenge, getPendingChallengeCount, getPendingChallenges, getMyOutgoingChallenges, completeChallenge, getDuelById, startQuickDuel, getRecentChallengeResults}; profile.{updateProfile, updateUsername, getPublicProfile, getPendingRequestCount, getProfileTodayRuns, getHeadToHead}; admin.rerollDailyAction; push-tokens.savePushToken.

games.pureApi:
types.ts: DraftGameConfig {countries: Country[]; categories: Category[]; costMatrix: number[][] /*[countryIdx][categoryIdx]=rank*/; optimalScore; optimalAssignment: number[] /*[countryIdx]=categoryIdx*/; mode: 'daily'|'practice'; dateKey}. DraftGameState {config; currentStep 0-7; assignments: (number|null)[]; usedCategories: Set<number>; phase: 'playing'|'results'; undoUsed: boolean}. DraftAssignment {countryIdx; categoryIdx; rank}. DraftResult {playerScore; optimalScore; gap; grade: 'perfect'|'excellent'|'great'|'good'|'okay'|'poor'; stars: number; assignments; optimalAssignments}.
engine.ts: createGame(rng, mode, dateKey): DraftGameState; canUndo(state): boolean (one undo per run, works on last pick even in 'results'); undoLastAssignment(state); getCurrentCountry(state): Country|null (null when not 'playing'); getAvailableCategories(state): {category, index}[]; canAssign(state, categoryIdx); assignCategory(state, categoryIdx) (8th pick flips phase to 'results', currentStep stays 7); isComplete(state).
generator.ts: generateDraftConfig(rng, mode, dateKey): picks 8 of 20 PREFERRED_CATEGORIES (population, area-km2, gdp-per-capita, gdp, life-expectancy, urban-population-pct, internet-users-pct, fertility-rate, tourism-arrivals, forest-coverage-pct, unemployment-rate, renewable-energy-pct, beer/coffee/wine-consumption-per-capita, inflation-rate, arable-land-pct, education-spending-pct, health-spending-pct, fdi-inflow) via seededPick; eligible countries = have a rank in all 8; up to 50 seededPick attempts for >=3 continents; costMatrix rank||999; reveal order seededShuffle; optimal via solveAssignment(costMatrix) (brute-force permutations, returns {optimalScore, assignment}).
scoring.ts: computeResult(state): DraftResult; gap thresholds grade: 0 perfect, <=10 excellent, <=25 great, <=50 good, <=100 okay, else poor; stars 5/4/3/2/1 (<=10:4, <=25:3, <=50:2).
server-validate.ts: validateCountryDraftResult(dateKey, scoreRaw, resultJson, edition): regenerates config with getDailyRng(dateKey, edition); checks 0<=scoreRaw<=1944, scoreRaw>=optimalScore, playerScore===scoreRaw, optimalScore===config.optimalScore, countryIso3s set-equal to config, assignments length 8 / idx ranges / unique categories / rank===costMatrix / sum===scoreRaw.

RESET action always re-inits practice with edition ''. Daily state persisted via useDailyProgress key dailyProgressKey('country-draft', today, edition) (Set serialised by storage.ts __ck_set tag).

games.title: Higher or Lower

engines.shared:
ROUTING AND PAGES
- Every game: landing /games/<slug> (src/app/games/<slug>/page.tsx, server component, `export const metadata = buildGameMetadata(slug)` from src/lib/seo/game-metadata.ts which sets canonical `/games/<slug>` + OG/Twitter; some pages also render <GameJsonLd {...buildGameJsonLd(slug)} /> and <PlayedTodayBanner gameSlug playHref/>), play /games/<slug>/play (src/app/games/<slug>/play/page.tsx, server component, metadata `{title: '<Title> · Play', robots: {index:false, follow:true}}`, reads `searchParams: Promise<{mode?: string}>`, gameMode = mode==='daily' ? 'daily' : 'practice', `edition = await getDailyEdition()`, renders <GameShell title backHref='/games/<slug>' mode={gameMode}>; daily wrapped in <DailyLockoutGuard gameSlug gameEmoji gameTitle edition>), plus opengraph-image.tsx per game (renderGameOgImageForSlug from src/lib/seo/og-image.tsx) and optional play/loading.tsx re-exporting GamePlayLoading. Indexed URLs to keep: /games, /games/<slug> for all 18 registry slugs (src/app/games/sitemap.ts emits one entry per getAllGames()), /games/<slug>/leaderboard (noindex), /games/<slug>/run/<runId> (noindex, has OG image). Practice-only boards (blitz, borderline, supremacy) ignore searchParams and always render mode='practice'; borderline and supremacy pages compute `practiceSeed = Date.now()` server-side and pass it as a prop.
- src/app/games/page.tsx: 'All games' index grouping registry into Daily puzzles (tier main + daily), Daily drills (daily, non-main), Practice only, In development (comingSoon); uses GameRow from src/components/home/game-list.tsx `GameRow({game: GameMeta, meta, href, tag?})` and emits ItemList + FAQPage JSON-LD.
- src/app/games/[slug]/leaderboard/page.tsx: server page; `getDailyLeaderboard(slug, dateKey, 50)` + `getFriendsLeaderboard` (tab=friends) + `getDailySummary`; date navigation via ?date=YYYY-MM-DD; rows link to /games/<slug>/run/<runId>; compact() strips 'Score: X (Gap: Y)' to 'X'; shows crest flag via profiles.country_code (toFlagCode from src/lib/silhouettes) else initial; CTA 'Shoot' to /play?mode=daily.
- src/app/games/[slug]/run/[runId]/page.tsx: getRunDetail(runId) (RPC get_run_detail) -> header with GAME_COLORS wash + RunDetailBody (src/components/game/run-detail/run-detail-body.tsx: BorderBuddiesBody, CountryDraftBody, StatGuesserBody, GenericBody which prints scoreDisplay/rank/percentile + labelled aggregates score,total,streak,bestStreak,avgError,accuracy,correct,rounds).

REGISTRY / DATA
- src/data/game-registry.json typed as GameMeta (src/types/game.ts): {slug,title,shortDescription,description,emoji,difficulty,estimatedTime,category,tier:'main'|'drill',isNew,isFlagship,availableModes: GameMode[],route,comingSoon?}. Accessors in src/lib/data/registry.ts (client-safe): gameRegistry, getAllGames, getGameBySlug, getFlagshipGame, getMainGames, getDrillGames (re-exported by src/lib/data/games.ts). src/lib/data/loader.ts exports countries: Country[], categories: Category[], centroids: Record<iso3,[lat,lng]>, getRanks(), getStats() (dynamic imports). src/lib/data/countries.ts: getAllCountries, getCountryByIso3, getCountryBySlug, getCountriesByRegion, getCountriesByContinent. src/lib/data/ranks.ts: getRank, getRanksForCountry, getStatValue, getTopCountries. Country type {iso2, iso3, name, displayName, slug, region, subregion, continent, flagEmoji, flagSvgPath, capital, borders: string[]}; Category {slug,label,shortLabel,clarifier?,unit,description,direction,source,sourceYear,coveragePercent,emoji}. Engines import JSON directly (stats.json, ranks.json, borders.json, capitals.json) — allowed in game-logic, not in components.

SEED SYSTEM (src/lib/daily-seed.ts, src/lib/seeded-random.ts, src/lib/daily-edition.ts)
- mulberry32(seed): () => number; seededShuffle(arr, rng); seededPick(arr, n, rng).
- dateSeed(dateKey): 31-bit string hash. getDailyRng(dateKey, edition='') = mulberry32(dateSeed(dateKey + edition)). getTodayDateKey() = Berlin date 'YYYY-MM-DD' via toLocaleDateString('en-CA', {timeZone:'Europe/Berlin'}). msUntilReset(), formatTimeUntilReset(ms) ('3h 42m').
- getDailyEdition() (server only): reads app_config.value where key='daily_edition' ('' on failure). Play pages pass it to boards as prop `edition`; submitGameRun re-reads it for server validators. Bumping the edition re-rolls every daily and invalidates lockout/progress keys (they embed `_e${edition}`).
- IMPORTANT: every daily board seeds with the plain dateKey + edition (no slug), so all games share one RNG stream start per day. The DB-side `ensure_daily_puzzle` RPC receives a different seed dateSeed(dateKey + gameSlug); it is not used by clients.
- Practice boards seed mulberry32(Date.now()) client-side (draft-board, flag-quiz, etc.); cluster and risk-zone gate practice render behind `mounted` to avoid hydration mismatch; country-draft gates all modes behind mounted.

SERVER ACTION src/app/actions/game-runs.ts ('use server')
- submitGameRun(input: {gameSlug; mode:'daily'|'practice'; dateKey; scoreRaw; scoreMax; scoreSortValue; scoreDisplay; resultJson: Record<string,unknown>; startedAt: ISO string}) => {success; run?: ServerGameRun; error?}. Steps: requires auth user (anonymous guest sessions count) else 'not_authenticated'; 'invalid_score' if scoreRaw > scoreMax && scoreMax>0; validateGameResult per slug (see per-game submission; unknown slug -> 'unvalidated_game'; exceptions -> 'validation_error'); daily: dateKey overwritten with server Berlin date; daily server replay validators for country-draft and stat-guesser with edition ('server_validation_failed: reason'); scoreSortValue override: scoreRaw for risk-zone, cluster, flag-quiz, capital-match, odd-one-out, country-streak, speed-flags, blitz, continent-sprint, border-buddies, population-sort, stat-guesser, supremacy, higher-or-lower; 1944-scoreRaw for country-draft; scoreMax-scoreRaw for geo-wordle and borderline; 'invalid_start_time' if startedAt not finite or >5 s in future; 'too_fast' if completed-started < 3000 ms; idempotency: existing run with same user/game/started_at is returned as success; daily: rpc ensure_daily_puzzle(p_game_slug, p_daily_date, p_seed) -> daily_puzzle_id; insert into game_runs {user_id, game_slug, daily_puzzle_id, mode, daily_date, score_raw, score_max, score_sort_value, score_display, result_json, started_at, completed_at}; unique violation 23505 -> 'already_played'; daily: rpc compute_daily_rankings + updateStreak (aggregation over game_runs.daily_date with streak freezes on profiles); personal best from user_game_stats (trigger-maintained) -> is_personal_best; returns mapGameRun(row) as ServerGameRun {id, gameSlug, mode, dailyDate, scoreRaw, scoreMax, scoreDisplay, scoreSortValue, scoreNormalized, rankDaily, percentile, isPersonalBest, resultJson, completedAt}.
- Other exports: checkDailyStatus(gameSlug, dateKey) -> {played, run?}; getDailyLeaderboard(gameSlug, dateKey, limit=50) (RPC get_daily_leaderboard) -> LeaderboardEntry[]; getRunDetail(runId) -> RunDetail|null; getDailySummary(gameSlug, dateKey) -> {playerCount, avgScore, topScoreRaw, topScoreDisplay}; getUserGameStats(gameSlug); getUserTodayRuns(userId) -> TodayRun[]. Types in src/types/server.ts.

BOARD CONTRACT (identical in all 14 submitting boards)

engines.notes:
Quirks and inconsistencies an architect should decide on (all verified in source):
1. Seed scoping: daily RNG = getDailyRng(dateKey, edition) with NO slug component, so every daily game consumes the same mulberry32 stream on a given day (they diverge only by how many draws each engine takes). The DB seed passed to ensure_daily_puzzle is dateSeed(dateKey + slug) and is unrelated to the puzzle actually shown. Server validators for country-draft and stat-guesser depend on the exact draw order of generateDraftConfig/createStatGuesser — any change to those engines' RNG consumption changes the daily puzzle AND must be mirrored in server-validate.ts.
2. Registry vs code mismatches: continent-sprint and speed-flags are practice-only in the registry, yet their play pages and boards fully wire mode=daily (DailyLockoutGuard, useDailyProgress, lockout, daily submit). continent-sprint's engine has no rng at all (createSprint() takes none; Date.now() inside the engine), so a 'daily' there is neither deterministic nor shared. blitz/borderline/supremacy boards accept a dailyKey prop (getDailyRng(dailyKey) without edition) but never receive one, never submit, and have no persistence.
3. Population Sort: registry copy says 5 countries, engine default and landing say 6; top bar hard-codes '/5' and progressCurrent 0. Capital Match top bar passes progressCurrent=score. Country Streak top bar uses progressTotal 20 as a purely visual cap. Higher or Lower submits scoreMax = streak (so pct is always 100 if a tier were computed; the board omits maxScore to avoid it) and prints a 'Swipe up/down' hint without any touch handler.
4. Anti-cheat contract: submitGameRun rejects runs faster than 3 s after startedAt, requires startedAt not >5 s in the future, dedupes by (user, game, started_at), overrides scoreSortValue per slug, and for daily overwrites dateKey with the server's Berlin date. Client-side lockout (localStorage) is the only guard for guests; signed-in users are also blocked by the game_runs unique constraint (error 23505 -> 'already_played'). validateGameResult returns 'unvalidated_game' for unknown slugs, so any new game must be added to both the scoreSortValue switch and the validator switch (world-draft currently would be rejected).
5. Persistence versioning: useDailyProgress PROGRESS_VERSION = 4; any change to a persisted state shape needs a bump or old blobs restore into broken UI. country-draft state contains a Set (handled by storage.ts tagging). Lockout/progress keys embed `_e${edition}` so an admin edition bump silently resets everyone.
6. GameOverScreen: ALL_SUGGESTIONS only knows the 11 original games (no supremacy, borderline, blitz, geo-wordle, cluster, risk-zone, world-draft); totalPlayersToday is always 0 from boards so 'You beat N players' never renders; the daily-chain box relies on `daily_${slug}_${dateKey}_completed` flags written by setDailyLockout; push permission is requested on the first daily finish (native only). ChallengeFriendPicker is imported but unreachable (no duels per product rules).
7. Emoji: CLAUDE.md says no emoji in UI; the current boards still use emoji glyphs in risk-zone results (💥🎲🏦), PickFeedback glyphs (✓→✗ are text), speed-flags feedback, border/sprint ✓/✗, and the share grids (intentional, text-only). The DailyLockoutGuard gameEmoji prop is accepted but unused.
8. Run-detail bodies exist only for border-buddies, country-draft, stat-guesser; other games fall back to GenericBody reading resultJson keys score/total/streak/bestStreak/avgError/accuracy/correct/rounds — keep those keys if run pages must keep rendering.
9. DB objects referenced (not all in supabase/migrations; base tables were created out-of-band): tables game_runs, user_game_stats, profiles (streak_current/longest, streak_freezes, streak_frozen_dates, last_daily_date, country_code, display_name), daily_puzzles, app_config(key='daily_edition'); RPCs ensure_daily_puzzle, compute_daily_rankings, get_daily_leaderboard, get_run_detail, get_daily_summary; trigger handle_new_user (anonymous sessions get a random geo handle).
10. Landing pages mostly pass a legacy `emoji` prop that GameLanding ignores; titles/descriptions/rules there are the human copy, while SEO title/description come from buildGameMetadata (src/lib/seo/game-metadata.ts) and prose/FAQ from GAME_COPY (src/lib/seo/game-copy.ts, has entries for all 18 slugs). Keep canonical `/games/<slug>` and the /games/sitemap.xml shard.

- /Users/adamkahirov/Desktop/code/countrivo/src/lib/profanity.ts: `export function isAllowedHandle(value: string): boolean`

### Mounting order (src/app/layout.tsx, root layout)
```
<AuthProvider>
  <NativeBootstrap />
  <ToastProvider>
    <Header />
    <AuthModal />
    <main className="flex-1">{children}</main>
    <FooterGate><Footer /></FooterGate>
    <BottomTabBar />
    <Analytics /><SpeedInsights />
  </ToastProvider>
</AuthProvider>
```
NativeBootstrap MUST sit inside AuthProvider. AuthModal is rendered once globally, controlled purely by context state.

### AuthProvider API (exported: `AuthProvider({ children })`, `useAuth(): AuthState`)
```ts
interface AuthState {
  user: User | null;                        // @supabase/supabase-js User
  profile: Profile | null;                  // mapped from public.profiles (camelCase)
  loading: boolean;                         // true until getUser resolves OR a 3000 ms timeout fires
  authModalOpen: boolean;
  openAuthModal: (onSuccess?: () => void) => void;
  closeAuthModal: () => void;
  signOut: () => Promise<void>;
  joinAsGuest: (displayName: string) => Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }>;
}
interface Profile { id: string; username: string; displayName: string | null; avatarUrl: string | null; countryCode: string | null; streakCurrent: number; streakLongest: number; lastDailyDate: string | null; createdAt: string; }
```
Default context values: user null, profile null, loading true, authModalOpen false, openAuthModal noop, closeAuthModal noop, signOut async noop, joinAsGuest -> `{ ok: false }`.

### Behavioural invariants inside AuthProvider (all load-bearing)
1. `userRef` (useRef<User|null>) mirrors `user` state and is written only in effects/handlers. `openAuthModal` reads `userRef.current`, NOT state, and its identity is stable (`useCallback([], …)`), because 16 game boards pass it as an effect dependency.
2. `openAuthModal(onSuccess)`: if `userRef.current` is set (real OR anonymous guest session) it calls `void onSuccess?.()` immediately and returns WITHOUT opening the modal. Otherwise stores `callbackRef.current = onSuccess ?? null` and sets `authModalOpen = true`.
3. `closeAuthModal()`: sets `authModalOpen = false` and clears `callbackRef.current = null`.
4. `profileGenRef` (useRef(0)) guard: every background `fetchProfile(uid)` captures `gen = profileGenRef.current` before awaiting and only does `setProfile(p)` if `gen === profileGenRef.current` afterwards. Any local write of a fresher profile (guest rename, profile-edit result) MUST do `profileGenRef.current++` before `setProfile(...)` so an in-flight stale fetch cannot overwrite it.
5. Initial effect: `supabase.auth.getUser()` with a 3 s `setTimeout(() => setLoading(false), 3000)` fallback; on user -> set userRef, setUser, guarded fetchProfile; `.finally` clears timeout and setLoading(false).
6. `supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => …)`: sets userRef/user/loading=false synchronously. If no user: `setProfile(null)`, `void clearPersistedSession()`, return. If user: ALL follow-up work is deferred with `setTimeout(..., 0)` (Supabase holds its auth lock during the callback, especially INITIAL_SESSION; awaiting any supabase call inside deadlocks). Inside the deferred block: guarded fetchProfile; `void persistSession()` (native mirror, no-op on web); if `event === "PASSWORD_RECOVERY"` return early (don't run callback, don't close modal, let /auth/reset-password handle it); else `await callbackRef.current?.()` in try/catch, null it, then `setAuthModalOpen(false)`. So the modal closes itself on successful sign-in via the auth state event, not via the modal's own code.
7. `signOut()`: `await clearPersistedSession()` THEN `await supabase.auth.signOut()`, then userRef=null, setUser(null), setProfile(null).
8. `fetchProfile(userId)` = `from("profiles").select("*").eq("id", userId).single()` via the BROWSER client; maps snake_case -> Profile (streak_* default 0).

### joinAsGuest(displayName) exact flow
- `supabase.auth.signInAnonymously()`. On success set `userRef.current = data.user` SYNCHRONOUSLY (the caller invokes `onJoined -> openAuthModal(submit)` on the next line and must hit the short-circuit).
- On error: if `/anonymous/i.test(error.message)` return `{ ok:false, error:"Guest play is not enabled yet. Try signing in instead." }` else `{ ok:false, error: error.message }`.
- Validate `name = displayName.trim()`: length 1..30 else `{ ok:false, error:"Pick a name between 1 and 30 characters" }`; `isAllowedHandle(name)` else `{ ok:false, error:"That name isn't allowed" }`.
- Rename through the BROWSER client (RLS own row), not a server action: `from("profiles").update({ display_name: name, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq("id", uid).select("*").single()`.
- If the update errors: fire-and-forget `updateProfile({ displayName: name, countryCode: null })` server action and on success `profileGenRef.current++; setProfile(r.profile)`; still return `{ ok: true }` (session exists; the run will save).
- If row returned: `profileGenRef.current++; setProfile(mapped row)`; return `{ ok: true }`.
- DB side: the `handle_new_user` trigger (supabase/migrations/20260828120000_handle_new_user_anonymous.sql) creates the profile row for anonymous users with username base "guest" (+ numeric suffix); the earlier migration 20260620100000_random_geo_handles.sql generates "adjective-noun-123" handles via `public.gen_geo_handle()` for email signups. Anonymous provider must be enabled in Supabase.

### Guest join UI: `LeaderboardJoin({ onJoined: () => void; daily: boolean })` (src/components/game/leaderboard-join.tsx)
- Single name input (maxLength 30, `autoCapitalize="words"`, Enter submits) + "Join" button (`cta-primary`). Copy: daily ? "Get on the leaderboard" : "Save this result"; sub "Just pick a name, no account needed."; busy label "Joining…"; empty-name error "Enter a name first"; fallback error "Could not join. Try again."
- Secondary link button: "Or sign in to keep your streak across devices" -> `openAuthModal(onJoined)`.
- On `joinAsGuest` ok -> `onJoined()`.
- Rendered by GameOverScreen when `onSaveScore && isDailyFinish` (`<LeaderboardJoin onJoined={onSaveScore} daily={isDailyFinish} />`) and directly by boards (e.g. draft-board.tsx line 353 `<LeaderboardJoin onJoined={handleSaveScore} daily={mode === "daily"} />`).

### Board -> auth -> submit contract (every game board, e.g. src/components/games/country-draft/draft-board.tsx)
```ts
const { user, openAuthModal } = useAuth();
// on completion: build payload (SubmitGameRunInput incl. startedAt: startedAtRef.current from useDailyProgress)
if (user) { const res = await submitGameRun(payload); if (res.success && res.run) setServerData(res.run); }
else setPendingPayload(payload);
// results phase:
const handleSaveScore = pendingPayload ? () => openAuthModal(async () => { const res = await submitGameRun(pendingPayload); if (res.success && res.run) setServerData(res.run); setPendingPayload(null); }) : undefined;
```
`submitGameRun` is idempotent on `(user_id, game_slug, started_at)` so a double submit (auth-change effect + join callback) returns the existing run.

### AuthModal (exported `AuthModal()`, no props; reads `authModalOpen`, `closeAuthModal` from useAuth)
- Tabs: `type Tab = "signin" | "signup"`, default "signin"; `role="tablist" aria-label="Sign in or sign up"`, buttons `role="tab" aria-selected`. Labels "Sign In" / "Sign Up". loadingStates.what: Every play route shows a one-size-fits-all skeleton (title bar, 64–80 px board box, 4 answer-button boxes) before the board appears.
loadingStates.cause: Each play page is `async` and awaits `searchParams` + `getDailyEdition()` (a Supabase `app_config` read) before rendering, so the whole route suspends on a DB round-trip.
loadingStates.fix: Read the edition once per request in a cached helper (or embed it in the daily seed material at build/cron time), pass it down as a plain prop, and render the board server-side with the daily seed in the same pass; drop the loading.tsx files.

loadingStates.what: Country Draft renders an `animate-pulse` placeholder (4 grey slot boxes) until `mounted` flips true, in BOTH daily and practice mode.
loadingStates.cause: `const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false); useEffect(() => setMounted(true), [])` gate added to 'prevent hydration mismatch' because `init()` uses `Date.now()` for practice seeds and the daily board is restored from localStorage via useDailyProgress.
loadingStates.fix: Daily: generate the board on the server from `getDailyRng(getTodayDateKey(), edition)` (already deterministic; `createGame(rng, mode, dateKey)` is pure) and render the real slots in the RSC; only the in-progress restore (assignments) needs a client effect and can overlay onto an already-visible board. Practice: pass a per-request seed prop from the server (the pattern supremacy/borderline already use with `practiceSeed`) instead of `Date.now()` on the client. Remove the mounted gate entirely.

loadingStates.what: Practice mode shows a blank placeholder (Cluster: skeleton; Risk Zone: GameSessionTopBar + `h-64 … opacity-50` empty box) until mount.
loadingStates.cause: `init()` seeds practice with `mulberry32(Date.now())` on the client, so SSR and hydration would disagree; the boards gate behind `mounted`.
loadingStates.fix: Server-supplied `practiceSeed` prop (as in supremacy/borderline play pages) so the first practice board is identical on server and client; reseed on 'Play again' client-side.

loadingStates.what: Practice boards compute `mulberry32(Date.now())` during render (SSR HTML differs from the client board → React hydration warnings/board swap on first paint); daily boards render the fresh board on the server then dispatch a RESTORE from localStorage in an effect, causing a visible jump from 'question 1' to the saved position.
loadingStates.cause: Seeds derived from `Date.now()` in `init()`, and `useDailyProgress` deliberately restores in an effect 'so server HTML and the first client render match'.
loadingStates.fix: Pass a server-generated seed (daily: date+edition, practice: per-request) so the initial board is deterministic; for resume, keep the progress restore but render the board immediately (it is already visible) and animate only the state delta; alternatively store progress server-side for signed-in players so the RSC can render the resumed state directly.

loadingStates.what: Daily play pages first render the live board, then (after mount) may swap to the 'Already played today' screen once localStorage is read; rank/percentile arrive later after auth resolves and a `checkDailyStatus` server-action round-trip.
loadingStates.cause: Lockout is decided client-side from `getDailyLockout(gameSlug, dateKey, edition)` in a `useEffect`, and server status is fetched only when `useAuth().loading` is false and a user exists.
loadingStates.fix: Decide lockout on the server: in the play page RSC read the session (supabase server client) + `game_runs` for (user, slug, dateKey); render the played-state page directly. For anonymous players either accept the flash or move the lockout marker to a cookie set on submit so the server can read it too.
